q: 你家有洗衣机___？
zh: 你家有洗衣机吗？
py: nǐ jiā yǒu xǐ yī jī ma
en: Do you have a washing machine at home?
why: A plain statement becomes a neutral yes/no question with 吗. 呢 needs a bare noun or a sentence that already is a question, and 的 and 呗 do not ask anything.

q: 你想喝什么___？
zh: 你想喝什么？
py: nǐ xiǎng hē shén me
en: What do you want to drink?
why: 什么 already makes this a question, so nothing more is added. 吗 is only for turning a statement into a yes/no question, never after a question word.

q: 你爸爸喜欢这个杯子___？
zh: 你爸爸喜欢这个杯子吗？
py: nǐ bà ba xǐ huan zhè gè bēi zi ma
en: Does your dad like this cup?
why: The speaker has no idea and asks a neutral yes/no question, so the sentence takes 吗. 呢 cannot turn a statement into a yes/no question, and 的 or 呗 make no question at all.

q: 你要现金还是刷卡___？
zh: 你要现金还是刷卡？
py: nǐ yào xiàn jīn hái shì shuā kǎ
en: Will you pay cash or by card?
why: 还是 already asks the listener to choose, so the sentence is complete. Adding 吗 would pile a second question marker on top of 还是, which no native does.

q: 你们明天去不去超市___？
zh: 你们明天去不去超市？
py: nǐ men míng tiān qù bù qù chāo shì
en: Are you going to the supermarket tomorrow or not?
why: 去不去 is the question, an A-not-A form. 吗 would double it, so the sentence ends right after 超市.

q: 我不知道是谁的，这个钱包是你的___？
zh: 我不知道是谁的，这个钱包是你的吗？
py: wǒ bù zhī dào shì shuí de zhè gè qián bāo shì nǐ de ma
en: I don't know whose it is. Is this wallet yours?
why: The speaker has no guess and asks a neutral yes/no question: 吗. 嘛 says the answer is obvious and never asks, and 呢 cannot make a statement a question.

q: 你是想知道哪家超市的东西最便宜___？
zh: 你是想知道哪家超市的东西最便宜吗？
py: nǐ shì xiǎng zhī dào nǎ jiā chāo shì de dōng xi zuì biàn yi ma
en: Do you want to know which supermarket has the cheapest things?
why: 哪家 sits inside a clause after 想知道; the whole sentence asks yes or no (do you want to know...), so it takes 吗. The wh-word does not make the main sentence a wh-question.

q: 你们家每个月的水电费都是妈妈一个人付___？
zh: 你们家每个月的水电费都是妈妈一个人付吗？
py: nǐ men jiā měi gè yuè de shuǐ diàn fèi dōu shì mā ma yī gè rén fù ma
en: Is it always Mom alone who pays the utility bills every month?
why: The sentence is a statement with no question word or A-not-A, so a yes/no question needs 吗. 嘛 would claim it is obvious, and 呢 or 呗 do not ask a yes/no question.

q: 我吃面条，你___？
zh: 我吃面条，你呢？
py: wǒ chī miàn tiáo nǐ ne
en: I'm having noodles. What about you?
why: Pronoun + 呢 bounces the same question back: "and you?". 吗 needs a full statement before it, so 你吗 does not work here.

q: 我的钥匙___？
zh: 我的钥匙呢？
py: wǒ de yào shi ne
en: Where are my keys?
why: A bare noun + 呢 asks where something is. 吗 would need a full statement, and 了 or 的 cannot follow a bare noun.

q: 妈妈去超市了，爸爸___？
zh: 妈妈去超市了，爸爸呢？
py: mā ma qù chāo shì le bà ba ne
en: Mom went to the supermarket. What about Dad?
why: The pattern "A did this; and what about B?" is noun + 呢. 吗 does not attach to a bare noun.

q: 这个太贵了，那个___？
zh: 这个太贵了，那个呢？
py: zhè gè tài guì le nà gè ne
en: This one is too expensive. What about that one?
why: Comparing a second item to the first one is noun + 呢 ("what about that one?"). 吗 needs a full statement, and 嘛 states the obvious and never asks.

q: 你到底想不想买这台电视___？
zh: 你到底想不想买这台电视呢？
py: nǐ dào dǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng mǎi zhè tái diàn shì ne
en: So do you want to buy this TV or not?
why: 想不想 is already the question, so 吗 is impossible after it. 呢 only makes it sound a little impatient or thoughtful.

q: 我们怎么把这个大沙发搬回家___？
zh: 我们怎么把这个大沙发搬回家呢？
py: wǒ men zěn me bǎ zhè gè dà shā fā bān huí jiā ne
en: So how are we going to get this big sofa home?
why: 怎么 makes this a question-word question, so 吗 cannot be added. 呢 is the particle that can soften such a question.

q: 你昨天说奶奶要来，她什么时候到___？
zh: 你昨天说奶奶要来，她什么时候到呢？
py: nǐ zuó tiān shuō nǎi nai yào lái tā shén me shí hòu dào ne
en: You said yesterday that Grandma is coming. When does she arrive?
why: 什么时候 asks for information, so 吗 is impossible; 呢 can soften the question.

q: 家里的钱已经不够了，下个月的房租怎么办___？
zh: 家里的钱已经不够了，下个月的房租怎么办呢？
py: jiā lǐ de qián yǐ jīng bù gòu le xià gè yuè de fáng zū zěn me bàn ne
en: The money at home is already not enough. What are we going to do about next month's rent?
why: 怎么办 is a question-word question, so 吗 fails. 呢 adds a worried, thinking-aloud tone to the question.

q: 别吵，弟弟在写作业___。
zh: 别吵，弟弟在写作业呢。
py: bié chǎo dì di zài xiě zuò yè ne
en: Don't make noise; my younger brother is doing homework.
why: 在 + verb + 呢 says the action is going on right now. 吗 would make it a question, and 吧 and 的 do not mark an ongoing action.

q: 爸爸还没回家___。
zh: 爸爸还没回家呢。
py: bà ba hái méi huí jiā ne
en: Dad hasn't come home yet.
why: 还没 means nothing has changed yet, so 了 is impossible. 呢 marks "still the case".

q: 现在才六点___，再睡一会儿。
zh: 现在才六点呢，再睡一会儿。
py: xiàn zài cái liù diǎn ne zài shuì yī huì r
en: It's only six o'clock now; sleep a little longer.
why: 才 + time + 呢 stresses "only", against the listener's assumption that it is late. 了 would announce a change, but the situation has not changed.

q: 妈妈正在做饭___，你先别进去。
zh: 妈妈正在做饭呢，你先别进去。
py: mā ma zhèng zài zuò fàn ne nǐ xiān bié jìn qù
en: Mom is cooking right now; don't go in yet.
why: 正在 + verb + 呢 describes what is happening at this moment. 了 would say the cooking is finished or has started, and 吗 would make a question.

q: 这件外套我还没付钱___，不能带走。
zh: 这件外套我还没付钱呢，不能带走。
py: zhè jiàn wài tào wǒ hái méi fù qián ne bù néng dài zǒu
en: I haven't paid for this coat yet, so I can't take it.
why: 还没付钱 describes a situation that has not changed, so 呢. 了 contradicts 还没, and 吧 would turn it into a guess.

q: 门口站着好几个人___，你去看看是谁。
zh: 门口站着好几个人呢，你去看看是谁。
py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe hǎo jǐ gè rén ne nǐ qù kàn kàn shì shuí
en: Several people are standing at the door; go and see who it is.
why: Verb + 着 + 呢 reports a state that is going on right now. 吗 would ask a question, and 的 and 呗 do not describe a current state.

q: 你以为我会买吗？我才不买___！
zh: 你以为我会买吗？我才不买呢！
py: nǐ yǐ wèi wǒ huì mǎi ma wǒ cái bù mǎi ne
en: You think I'd buy it? I certainly won't buy it!
why: 才不 + verb + 呢 is a strong denial: "certainly not". 吗 would turn the denial into a question, and 吧 would soften it into a guess.

q: 别急着收拾，爷爷奶奶还没到___，客人都要六点以后才来。
zh: 别急着收拾，爷爷奶奶还没到呢，客人都要六点以后才来。
py: bié jí zhe shōu shí yé ye nǎi nai hái méi dào ne kè rén dōu yào liù diǎn yǐ hòu cái lái
en: Don't rush to tidy up. Grandpa and Grandma haven't arrived yet, and the guests won't come until after six.
why: 还没到 says the arrival has not happened, so the sentence takes 呢 for "still the case". 了 clashes with 还没, and 吗 would ask instead of reassure.

q: 这个月的工资还没发___，我哪有钱买新手机？
zh: 这个月的工资还没发呢，我哪有钱买新手机？
py: zhè gè yuè de gōng zī hái méi fā ne wǒ nǎ yǒu qián mǎi xīn shǒu jī
en: This month's pay hasn't come in yet; where would I get money for a new phone?
why: 还没发 is a situation that has not changed, which is 呢, never 了. 吗 would ask whether it has come in, but the speaker is giving a reason.

q: 我们回家___。
zh: 我们回家吧。
py: wǒ men huí jiā ba
en: Let's go home.
why: "Let's..." is a suggestion, which is 吧. 吗 would ask "are we going home?", and 呢 or 的 make no proposal.

q: 天太热了，你们喝点水___。
zh: 天太热了，你们喝点水吧。
py: tiān tài rè le nǐ men hē diǎn shuǐ ba
en: It's too hot; why don't you drink some water.
why: A gentle recommendation takes 吧. 吗 would ask whether they drink water, and 呢 or 了 do not make a suggestion.

q: 这个杯子很便宜，你买___。
zh: 这个杯子很便宜，你买吧。
py: zhè gè bēi zi hěn biàn yi nǐ mǎi ba
en: This cup is cheap; why don't you buy it?
why: The speaker recommends an action, which is 吧. 吗 would ask a fact question about whether you buy it.

q: 太晚了，我们明天再去超市___。
zh: 太晚了，我们明天再去超市吧。
py: tài wǎn le wǒ men míng tiān zài qù chāo shì ba
en: It's too late; let's go to the supermarket tomorrow.
why: Proposing a new plan ("let's...") takes 吧. 吗 would ask a question instead of proposing, and 的 or 呢 do not make a proposal.

q: 好___，这个价钱我就买了。
zh: 好吧，这个价钱我就买了。
py: hǎo ba zhè gè jià qián wǒ jiù mǎi le
en: All right then, at this price I'll buy it.
why: 好吧 means giving in: "all right then". 好吗 would ask "OK?", and 好呢 or 好着 are not set phrases.

q: 你先把菜洗好，我来切___。
zh: 你先把菜洗好，我来切吧。
py: nǐ xiān bǎ cài xǐ hǎo wǒ lái qiè ba
en: You wash the vegetables first, and I'll chop them.
why: Splitting up the work is a proposal, so 吧 softens it. 吗 would ask whether I will chop, and 呢 would say I am chopping right now.

q: 要是价钱谈不下来，你就别买了，我们去别的店看看___。
zh: 要是价钱谈不下来，你就别买了，我们去别的店看看吧。
py: yào shì jià qián tán bù xià lái nǐ jiù bié mǎi le wǒ men qù bié de diàn kàn kàn ba
en: If you can't get the price down, don't buy it; let's look in other shops.
why: Proposing to look elsewhere is a suggestion: 吧. 吗 would ask a question, and 了 would claim they are already going.

q: 你妈妈累了一天了，今晚的碗就让我们来洗___。
zh: 你妈妈累了一天了，今晚的碗就让我们来洗吧。
py: nǐ mā ma lèi le yī tiān le jīn wǎn de wǎn jiù ràng wǒ men lái xǐ ba
en: Your mom has been tired all day; let's wash tonight's dishes ourselves.
why: "Let us do it" is a proposal, so 吧. 吗 would ask whether we wash them, and 呢 would describe it as going on now.

q: 我看你们很像，你是小王的妈妈___？
zh: 我看你们很像，你是小王的妈妈吧？
py: wǒ kàn nǐ men hěn xiàng nǐ shì xiǎo wáng de mā ma ba
en: You look alike, so you're Xiao Wang's mom, right?
why: The speaker has a guess (你们很像) and wants confirmation: 吧. 吗 would be a question with no opinion at all.

q: 你常常去那家超市，你家离那儿很近___？
zh: 你常常去那家超市，你家离那儿很近吧？
py: nǐ cháng cháng qù nà jiā chāo shì nǐ jiā lí nà r hěn jìn ba
en: You often go to that supermarket, so your home is close to it, I suppose?
why: Because you often go there is a clue, the speaker already believes it and wants a "right?": 吧. 吗 would mean the speaker has no idea.

q: 这条裙子看起来很好，不便宜___？
zh: 这条裙子看起来很好，不便宜吧？
py: zhè tiáo qún zi kàn qǐ lái hěn hǎo bù biàn yi ba
en: This skirt looks nice; it isn't cheap, I suppose?
why: A guess based on appearance, hoping for agreement, takes 吧. 吗 would ask with no opinion, and 的 makes no question.

q: 你们家今年大概不回老家过年了___？
zh: 你们家今年大概不回老家过年了吧？
py: nǐ men jiā jīn nián dà gài bù huí lǎo jiā guò nián le ba
en: You probably won't go back to your hometown for New Year this year, I suppose?
why: 大概 marks a guess, so the sentence takes 吧. 吗 would ask with no opinion and sounds odd with 大概.

q: 爸爸应该已经买好票了___？
zh: 爸爸应该已经买好票了吧？
py: bà ba yīng gāi yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo piào le ba
en: Dad should have bought the tickets already, I take it?
why: 应该 shows the speaker's guess and 吧 asks for confirmation. 吗 clashes with 应该, and 嘛 says it is obvious without asking.

q: 你一个月的工资一定不少___？
zh: 你一个月的工资一定不少吧？
py: nǐ yī gè yuè de gōng zī yī dìng bù shǎo ba
en: You surely earn a good salary a month, I suppose?
why: 一定 shows the speaker assumes it is so, and 吧 asks for confirmation. 吗 would be asked with no assumption.

q: 看你买了这么多东西，今天的特价活动你一定早就知道了___？
zh: 看你买了这么多东西，今天的特价活动你一定早就知道了吧？
py: kàn nǐ mǎi le zhè me duō dōng xi jīn tiān de tè jià huó dòng nǐ yī dìng zǎo jiù zhī dào le ba
en: Seeing how much you bought, you must have known about today's sale long ago, I take it?
why: The speaker infers from the evidence and asks for agreement, which is 吧. 吗 asks with no opinion, and 呢 or 的 do not ask.

q: 你刚搬来这个小区，邻居们还不太熟___？
zh: 你刚搬来这个小区，邻居们还不太熟吧？
py: nǐ gāng bān lái zhè gè xiǎo qū lín jū men hái bù tài shú ba
en: You just moved into this neighborhood, so you probably don't know the neighbors well yet?
why: The speaker infers from the fact that you just moved in and invites confirmation: 吧. 吗 would show no expectation at all.

q: 这个蛋糕真好吃___！
zh: 这个蛋糕真好吃啊！
py: zhè gè dàn gāo zhēn hǎo chī a
en: This cake is so delicious!
why: 真 + adjective + 啊 is a warm exclamation. 吗 would turn the exclamation into a yes/no question, and 的 and 了 do not fit.

q: 妈妈做的饭多香___！
zh: 妈妈做的饭多香啊！
py: mā ma zuò de fàn duō xiāng a
en: How tasty Mom's cooking is!
why: 多 + adjective + 啊 is an exclamation. 吗 would ask a question, and 吧 would make it a guess.

q: 快来___，饭做好了！
zh: 快来啊，饭做好了！
py: kuài lái a fàn zuò hǎo le
en: Come on, hurry, the meal is ready!
why: 啊 makes friendly urging: "come on!". 吗 would ask "are you coming?", and 的 and 呢 do not urge.

q: 这家店的衣服真便宜！是___，我们多买几件。
zh: 这家店的衣服真便宜！是啊，我们多买几件。
py: zhè jiā diàn de yī fu zhēn biàn yi shì a wǒ men duō mǎi jǐ jiàn
en: The clothes in this shop are so cheap! Yes, they are; let's buy a few more.
why: 是啊 is warm agreement: "yes, exactly". 是吗 would ask "really?", which does not fit the speaker agreeing.

q: 奶奶，您慢点走___，小心台阶！
zh: 奶奶，您慢点走啊，小心台阶！
py: nǎi nai nín màn diǎn zǒu a xiǎo xīn tái jiē
en: Grandma, walk slowly, mind the steps!
why: 啊 gives a caring, urging tone to the warning. 吗 would ask a question, and 呗 would sound careless, the opposite of caring.

q: 这个孩子长得多可爱___！
zh: 这个孩子长得多可爱啊！
py: zhè gè hái zi zhǎng de duō kě ài a
en: How cute this child is!
why: 多可爱 + 啊 is an exclamation. 吗 would ask a question, and 吧 would turn it into a guess. 嘛 would say it is obvious.

q: 你们看，这个小区的环境多好___，楼下还有一个大超市！
zh: 你们看，这个小区的环境多好啊，楼下还有一个大超市！
py: nǐ men kàn zhè gè xiǎo qū de huán jìng duō hǎo a lóu xià hái yǒu yī gè dà chāo shì
en: Look how nice this neighborhood is, and there's a big supermarket downstairs!
why: 多好 + 啊 is an exclamation of delight. 吗 would turn it into a yes/no question, and 吧 would make a guess out of what the speaker can see.

q: 能和家人一起过年，真是太幸福___！
zh: 能和家人一起过年，真是太幸福啊！
py: néng hé jiā rén yī qǐ guò nián zhēn shì tài xìng fú a
en: Being able to spend New Year with the family is such happiness!
why: 真是太 + adjective + 啊 is a warm exclamation. 吗 would ask a question, which is the opposite of an exclamation.

q: 你是我哥哥___，当然要帮我。
zh: 你是我哥哥嘛，当然要帮我。
py: nǐ shì wǒ gē ge ma dāng rán yào bāng wǒ
en: You're my older brother, after all; of course you should help me.
why: 嘛 says "obviously, after all" and never asks. 吗 would turn it into a question and spoil 当然 in the next clause.

q: 太贵了，不买就不买___。
zh: 太贵了，不买就不买呗。
py: tài guì le bù mǎi jiù bù mǎi bei
en: It's too expensive. If we don't buy it, we don't buy it.
why: 不...就不...呗 means "so be it, no big deal". 吗 would ask a question, and 呢 or 的 do not give the shrug.

q: 我早就说过___，这家店最便宜。
zh: 我早就说过嘛，这家店最便宜。
py: wǒ zǎo jiù shuō guò ma zhè jiā diàn zuì biàn yi
en: I told you long ago, didn't I: this shop is the cheapest.
why: 嘛 says "you should know this by now", a mild reproach. 吗 would ask whether I said it, but the speaker knows they did.

q: 你想吃就吃___，家里又不缺吃的。
zh: 你想吃就吃呗，家里又不缺吃的。
py: nǐ xiǎng chī jiù chī bei jiā lǐ yòu bù quē chī de
en: If you want to eat it, just eat it; it's not as if we're short of food at home.
why: 想...就... + 呗 gives a casual "just do it". 吗 would ask a question, and 的 or 呢 do not mean "just".

q: 孩子还小___，你别要求他自己洗衣服。
zh: 孩子还小嘛，你别要求他自己洗衣服。
py: hái zi hái xiǎo ma nǐ bié yào qiú tā zì jǐ xǐ yī fu
en: The child is still little, after all; don't demand that he wash his own clothes.
why: The speaker is pointing to an obvious reason: 嘛. 吗 would ask whether the child is little, which does not support the advice that follows.

q: 这个价钱本来就不高___，不用再砍价了。
zh: 这个价钱本来就不高嘛，不用再砍价了。
py: zhè gè jià qián běn lái jiù bù gāo ma bù yòng zài kǎn jià le
en: This price wasn't high to begin with, so there's no need to bargain any more.
why: 本来就 sets up an obvious fact, so the sentence ends with 嘛. 吗 would turn it into a question, and 吧 would turn it into a guess.

q: 不喜欢这个颜色就换一个___，店里还有很多别的颜色。
zh: 不喜欢这个颜色就换一个呗，店里还有很多别的颜色。
py: bù xǐ huan zhè gè yán sè jiù huàn yī gè bei diàn lǐ hái yǒu hěn duō bié de yán sè
en: If you don't like this color, just swap it for another; the shop has plenty of other colors.
why: ...就... + 呗 treats the fix as obvious and easy. 吗 would ask a question, and 呢 or 的 do not carry the "just do it" attitude.

q: 他自己愿意花钱买，你就让他买___，反正是他自己的零花钱。
zh: 他自己愿意花钱买，你就让他买呗，反正是他自己的零花钱。
py: tā zì jǐ yuàn yì huā qián mǎi nǐ jiù ràng tā mǎi bei fǎn zhèng shì tā zì jǐ de líng huā qián
en: If he's willing to spend his own money, just let him buy it; it's his own pocket money anyway.
why: 让他买 + 呗 is a casual "just let him". 吗 would ask a question, and 反正 in the next clause shows the speaker is shrugging, not asking.

q: 别哭了，爸爸一定会来___。
zh: 别哭了，爸爸一定会来的。
py: bié kū le bà ba yī dìng huì lái de
en: Don't cry; Dad will definitely come.
why: 一定会 + 的 is a calm reassurance about the future. 了 would announce that something has changed, and 吗 would ask a question.

q: 我保证，这个杯子不会坏___。
zh: 我保证，这个杯子不会坏的。
py: wǒ bǎo zhèng zhè gè bēi zi bù huì huài de
en: I promise, this cup won't break.
why: 我保证 asks for a firm assurance: 不会...的. 吧 would soften it to a guess, which clashes with 保证.

q: 别担心钱的事，我们家的日子会越来越好___。
zh: 别担心钱的事，我们家的日子会越来越好的。
py: bié dān xīn qián de shì wǒ men jiā de rì zi huì yuè lái yuè hǎo de
en: Don't worry about money; our family's life will get better and better.
why: 会...的 gives the listener a calm assurance. 了 would claim it has already happened, and 吧 would make it a guess.

q: 你放心，我不会告诉妈妈这件事___。
zh: 你放心，我不会告诉妈妈这件事的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ bù huì gào sù mā ma zhè jiàn shì de
en: Don't worry, I won't tell Mom about this.
why: 不会 + verb + 的 is the promise form. 吧 would weaken a promise to a guess, and 了 does not follow 不会.

q: 虽然现在东西很贵，但是你相信我，过几个月价钱一定会降___。
zh: 虽然现在东西很贵，但是你相信我，过几个月价钱一定会降的。
py: suī rán xiàn zài dōng xi hěn guì dàn shì nǐ xiāng xìn wǒ guò jǐ gè yuè jià qián yī dìng huì jiàng de
en: Things are expensive now, but trust me, prices will definitely drop in a few months.
why: The speaker is giving a firm assurance about the future: 一定会...的. 了 would report a change that has already happened.

q: 你不用担心奶奶，她的病只要好好吃药，很快就会好___。
zh: 你不用担心奶奶，她的病只要好好吃药，很快就会好的。
py: nǐ bù yòng dān xīn nǎi nai tā de bìng zhǐ yào hǎo hǎo chī yào hěn kuài jiù huì hǎo de
en: No need to worry about Grandma; as long as she takes her medicine, she will soon be well.
why: 会好 + 的 is the reassurance. 吧 would turn the comfort into a doubtful guess, and 吗 would ask a question.

q: 我已经不想买手机___。
zh: 我已经不想买手机了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng bù xiǎng mǎi shǒu jī le
en: I don't want to buy a phone any more.
why: 不想...了 means "not any more", a change from before. 呢 would mean it is still so, and 吗 would ask a question.

q: 天黑___，我们回家吧。
zh: 天黑了，我们回家吧。
py: tiān hēi le wǒ men huí jiā ba
en: It's dark now; let's go home.
why: Final 了 says the situation is new: it has become dark. 呢 would say it is still dark, and 的 is not used for a change.

q: 弟弟现在有手机___。
zh: 弟弟现在有手机了。
py: dì di xiàn zài yǒu shǒu jī le
en: My younger brother has a phone now.
why: 现在 plus final 了 marks a new situation: he did not have one before. 吗 would ask a question, and 的 does not report a change.

q: 这家店现在不打折___，你来晚了。
zh: 这家店现在不打折了，你来晚了。
py: zhè jiā diàn xiàn zài bù dǎ zhé le nǐ lái wǎn le
en: This shop isn't having sales any more; you came too late.
why: 不打折了 means the discounts have stopped, a change from before. 呢 would say they still are not on, but 来晚了 shows a change.

q: 我的钱包里没有钱___，得去银行取一点。
zh: 我的钱包里没有钱了，得去银行取一点。
py: wǒ de qián bāo lǐ méi yǒu qián le děi qù yín xíng qǔ yī diǎn
en: There's no money left in my wallet now; I have to withdraw some at the bank.
why: 没有钱了 means money that used to be there is gone, a change. 吗 would ask a question, and 的 does not report a change.

q: 孩子们都长大___，不再需要我们每天接送了。
zh: 孩子们都长大了，不再需要我们每天接送了。
py: hái zi men dōu zhǎng dà le bù zài xū yào wǒ men měi tiān jiē sòng le
en: The children have all grown up and no longer need us to take them to and from school every day.
why: Final 了 says the change has happened: they are grown now. 呢 would say they are still growing, which contradicts 不再需要.

q: 他现在是我们小区最大的超市老板___，过去只是个小店员。
zh: 他现在是我们小区最大的超市老板了，过去只是个小店员。
py: tā xiàn zài shì wǒ men xiǎo qū zuì dà de chāo shì lǎo bǎn le guò qù zhǐ shì gè xiǎo diàn yuán
en: He is now the owner of the biggest supermarket in our neighborhood; in the past he was just a small clerk.
why: 现在 and 过去 set up a before-and-after, so the new state takes 了. 吗 would ask a question, and 的 or 呗 do not mark a change.

zh: 我们一起回家吧。
py: wǒ men yī qǐ huí jiā ba
en: Let's go home together.
why: 吧 closes the suggestion after the whole action 一起回家; 一起 must stay in front of 回家.

zh: 爷爷还没起床呢。
py: yé ye hái méi qǐ chuáng ne
en: Grandpa hasn't got up yet.
why: 还没 comes right before the verb and 呢 closes the sentence, giving "still the case".

zh: 你喜欢这件衣服吗？
py: nǐ xǐ huan zhè jiàn yī fu ma
en: Do you like this piece of clothing?
why: 吗 always goes at the very end. The object may be moved to the front as a topic, and that order is also correct.

zh: 我的钱包呢？
py: wǒ de qián bāo ne
en: Where is my wallet?
why: Noun + 呢 asks where something is. The particle must be last, after the whole noun phrase.

zh: 你一定早就知道这个价钱了吧。
py: nǐ yī dìng zǎo jiù zhī dào zhè gè jià qián le ba
en: You must have known this price long ago, I take it?
why: 了 comes before 吧 because 吧 is the last word of the sentence. 一定 comes before 早就, and the object can be fronted as a topic.

task: Turn it into a yes/no question.
zh: 你想喝茶吗？
py: nǐ xiǎng hē chá ma
en: Do you want to drink tea?
why: Add 吗 at the end of the statement; nothing else moves.

task: Soften it into a gentle suggestion.
zh: 你多喝点水吧。
py: nǐ duō hē diǎn shuǐ ba
en: Why don't you drink a bit more water.
why: 吧 at the end turns the instruction into a friendly suggestion.

task: Say he is sleeping right now.
zh: 弟弟在睡觉呢。
py: dì di zài shuì jué ne
en: My younger brother is sleeping.
why: 在 before the verb and 呢 at the end mark an action going on right now.

src_py: wǒ bù xiǎng mǎi nà tái jiù diàn shì
task: Say you don't want to buy it any more.
zh: 我不想买那台旧电视了。
py: wǒ bù xiǎng mǎi nà tái jiù diàn shì le
en: I don't want to buy that old TV any more.
why: 不想...了 means "not any more". The object can also be fronted as a topic, so both orders are right.

src_py: yé ye de bìng huì hǎo
task: Reassure the listener with 一定 and a final particle.
zh: 别担心，爷爷的病一定会好的。
py: bié dān xīn yé ye de bìng yī dìng huì hǎo de
en: Don't worry, Grandpa will definitely get better.
why: 一定会...的 gives a firm reassurance; 一定 sits before 会 and 的 ends the sentence.

s: 你家有几口人吗？
s_py: nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén ma
zh: 你家有几口人？
py: nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén
en: How many people are in your family?
why: 几 asks for a number, so the sentence is already a question and cannot take 吗.

s: 这个杯子你要不要吗？
s_py: zhè gè bēi zi nǐ yào bù yào ma
zh: 这个杯子你要不要？
py: zhè gè bēi zi nǐ yào bù yào
en: Do you want this cup or not?
why: 要不要 is an A-not-A question, so 吗 cannot be added.

s: 你想知道这件衣服多少钱吗？
s_py: nǐ xiǎng zhī dào zhè jiàn yī fu duō shǎo qián ma
zh: 你想知道这件衣服多少钱吗？
py: nǐ xiǎng zhī dào zhè jiàn yī fu duō shǎo qián ma
en: Do you want to know how much this piece of clothing costs?
why: 多少钱 sits inside the clause after 想知道, so the whole sentence is a yes/no question and 吗 is right.

s: 你是爸爸的朋友呢？
s_py: nǐ shì bà ba de péng you ne
zh: 你是爸爸的朋友吗？
py: nǐ shì bà ba de péng you ma
en: Are you Dad's friend?
why: 呢 cannot turn a statement into a yes/no question; that is the job of 吗.

s: 你们到底买不买呢？
s_py: nǐ men dào dǐ mǎi bù mǎi ne
zh: 你们到底买不买呢？
py: nǐ men dào dǐ mǎi bù mǎi ne
en: So are you buying or not?
why: 呢 is allowed after a question that already is one (买不买), and it makes the question sound impatient.

s: 你为什么不买吗？
s_py: nǐ wèi shén me bù mǎi ma
zh: 你为什么不买呢？
py: nǐ wèi shén me bù mǎi ne
en: Why aren't you buying it?
why: 为什么 already makes this a question, so 吗 is impossible; 呢 is the particle that can soften it.

s: 外面还下着大雨呢。
s_py: wài miàn hái xià zhe dà yǔ ne
zh: 外面还下着大雨呢。
py: wài miàn hái xià zhe dà yǔ ne
en: It's still pouring outside.
why: Verb + 着 + 呢 describes a state that is going on right now, so this sentence is correct.

s: 现在才五点了，你再睡一会儿。
s_py: xiàn zài cái wǔ diǎn le nǐ zài shuì yī huì r
zh: 现在才五点呢，你再睡一会儿。
py: xiàn zài cái wǔ diǎn ne nǐ zài shuì yī huì r
en: It's only five o'clock; sleep a little longer.
why: 才 stresses "only", the situation has not changed, so 了 fails; 才...呢 is the right pattern.

s: 时间不早了，我们快点去超市吗。
s_py: shí jiān bù zǎo le wǒ men kuài diǎn qù chāo shì ma
zh: 时间不早了，我们快点去超市吧。
py: shí jiān bù zǎo le wǒ men kuài diǎn qù chāo shì ba
en: It's getting late; let's hurry to the supermarket.
why: "Let's" is a proposal, which needs 吧; 吗 would ask a question and cannot end a statement with a full stop.

s: 这个价钱太高了，我们再看看别的吧。
s_py: zhè gè jià qián tài gāo le wǒ men zài kàn kàn bié de ba
zh: 这个价钱太高了，我们再看看别的吧。
py: zhè gè jià qián tài gāo le wǒ men zài kàn kàn bié de ba
en: This price is too high; let's look at other ones.
why: 吧 closes a proposal, so the sentence is correct.

s: 好吧，我们就买这个。
s_py: hǎo ba wǒ men jiù mǎi zhè gè
zh: 好吧，我们就买这个。
py: hǎo ba wǒ men jiù mǎi zhè gè
en: All right, let's buy this one then.
why: 好吧 means giving in, and it is a set phrase here.

s: 你是小李的姐姐吧吗？
s_py: nǐ shì xiǎo lǐ de jiě jie ba ma
zh: 你是小李的姐姐吧？
py: nǐ shì xiǎo lǐ de jiě jie ba
en: You're Xiao Li's older sister, right?
why: 吧 and 吗 are never used together; 吧 alone fits a guess.

s: 你不是第一次来这家店吧？
s_py: nǐ bù shì dì yī cì lái zhè jiā diàn ba
zh: 你不是第一次来这家店吧？
py: nǐ bù shì dì yī cì lái zhè jiā diàn ba
en: This isn't your first time in this shop, I suppose?
why: Negative statement + 吧 asks for confirmation of a guess; the sentence is correct.

s: 这个房间多干净吗！
s_py: zhè gè fáng jiān duō gàn jìng ma
zh: 这个房间多干净啊！
py: zhè gè fáng jiān duō gàn jìng a
en: How clean this room is!
why: 多...! is an exclamation and needs 啊; 吗 makes a yes/no question and cannot end an exclamation.

s: 你快说啊，到底花了多少钱？
s_py: nǐ kuài shuō a dào dǐ huā le duō shǎo qián
zh: 你快说啊，到底花了多少钱？
py: nǐ kuài shuō a dào dǐ huā le duō shǎo qián
en: Come on, say it; how much did you spend in the end?
why: 啊 adds urging, and 多少钱 is the question; 啊 does not turn it into a yes/no question.

s: 他还是个孩子嘛，别太严格。
s_py: tā hái shì gè hái zi ma bié tài yán gé
zh: 他还是个孩子嘛，别太严格。
py: tā hái shì gè hái zi ma bié tài yán gé
en: He's still a child, after all; don't be too strict.
why: 嘛 states the obvious reason, so the sentence is correct.

s: 你想买就买呗，反正是你自己的钱。
s_py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi jiù mǎi bei fǎn zhèng shì nǐ zì jǐ de qián
zh: 你想买就买呗，反正是你自己的钱。
py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi jiù mǎi bei fǎn zhèng shì nǐ zì jǐ de qián
en: If you want to buy it, just buy it; it's your own money anyway.
why: 就...呗 gives a casual "just do it", so the sentence is correct.

s: 别担心，他一定会回来了。
s_py: bié dān xīn tā yī dìng huì huí lái le
zh: 别担心，他一定会回来的。
py: bié dān xīn tā yī dìng huì huí lái de
en: Don't worry, he will definitely come back.
why: 一定会 looks to the future, so it takes the assuring 的; 了 reports a change and cannot follow 一定会.

s: 我不会把这件事告诉别人的。
s_py: wǒ bù huì bǎ zhè jiàn shì gào sù bié rén de
zh: 我不会把这件事告诉别人的。
py: wǒ bù huì bǎ zhè jiàn shì gào sù bié rén de
en: I won't tell anyone about this.
why: 不会...的 is a promise, so the sentence is correct.

s: 我的手机坏呢，我得买一个新的。
s_py: wǒ de shǒu jī huài ne wǒ děi mǎi yī gè xīn de
zh: 我的手机坏了，我得买一个新的。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī huài le wǒ děi mǎi yī gè xīn de
en: My phone is broken now; I have to buy a new one.
why: 坏 reports a new state, which needs 了, not 呢.

s: 妈妈今天不做饭了，我们去外面吃。
s_py: mā ma jīn tiān bù zuò fàn le wǒ men qù wài miàn chī
zh: 妈妈今天不做饭了，我们去外面吃。
py: mā ma jīn tiān bù zuò fàn le wǒ men qù wài miàn chī
en: Mom isn't cooking today after all; we'll eat out.
why: 不...了 marks a changed plan, so the sentence is correct.
